title: `x=( /usr/bin`<newline>`/usr/lo`: zsh inserts /usr/local/, zshrs leaves the word and prints two _describe errors

observed.detail: diverges at step #1 ('tab'); first diff row 1 col 7; 3 row(s) differ
observed.notes: Both shells answer the Enter with PS2 — the buffer is deliberately incomplete at the newline, so nothing executes and the completion fires inside the continuation. The single-line control below completes the same word with the newline removed and PASSES, which is what makes the CONTINUATION the variable rather than the word. Same two `_describe:compdescribe` diagnostics as the backslash continuation, from a completely different continuation context (an array literal that opened on the previous line), which is why the two are pinned separately rather than as variants of one another: the shared symptom is evidence about how far the defect reaches. Under `--no-zstyle` this cell PASSES on both shells, so the zstyle fixture is load-bearing and is recorded in `run.zstyle_file`.

controls.note: `x=( /usr/bin /usr/lo` on one line under the same zstyle fixture: PASSES.
